title: Corporation law applies in general.
bodyText: The laws of this State relating to private corporations, except where inconsistent with the express provisions of this code, shall apply to incorporated domestic insurers.
bodyHtml: §431:4-103  Corporation law applies in general.  The laws of this State relating to private corporations, except where inconsistent with the express provisions of this code, shall apply to incorporated domestic insurers. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
